direction.summary: Continue Character Spotlight guides using lower-cost deterministic workers for candidate mapping while retaining every protected decision and release action centrally.
direction.batch_target: Select the smallest coherent publishable chunk of four to six guides, reducing the count when data or review risk requires it.
excluded_work: Do not duplicate worker mapping work.
Do not treat worker prose as approval.

Do not delegate source-boundary acceptance, ambiguous identity decisions, metadata-horizon decisions, subset or partial overlap approval, batch selection, anchor reading, release authority, shared integration edits, Review, PR, CI interpretation, conflict reconciliation, or merge.
Run exactly one independent post-implementation Review.

wider.keyFinding: Worker reports are provisional until final cross-shard selection and central regeneration against the live library and every selected peer.

deeper.blocker: All three worker branches remain at their launch tips with zero recorded diff after restart. The parent is inspecting whether they are actively processing or stalled.
